author: Andrew Fisher
method: Original fixed-step physics; continuous lap checked at no more than 50 m intervals, rendered at twelve equal-distance lap positions plus the finish
limitations: Software-rendered Chromium, not a physical-device performance benchmark
Continuous simulation is accelerated; screenshots sample distance, not every rendered video frame
Geometry coverage is not proof of surveyed landmark accuracy
